title: 第223章 问此间（五十一）
content_zh:
无形之中，他忽然感觉到了封印的松动,在他的视线当中，那颗金芒灿烂的顽固道心,此刻正微不可见地震颤，四周无懈可击的囚笼，同时出现了一阵强、一阵弱的波澜。
心魔便如急于饮血的虫虱，迫不及待地扑在封印之上，趁松动之际,饥渴地吞食外界的天地能量。
嗯,死是不太可能死了,他夺了神躯龙心，理所应当算作半个至恶，自然可以感觉到,至善的力量一日强过一日,稍稍一想,便知道本尊干了什么好事,他定然为了哄得至善心花怒放,主动拔了善恶交接的锚点,并且不止一处。
很有可能是远离了刘扶光的原因,心魔又能冷静地思考，而不必受至善的邪门蛊惑。刘扶光的魅力退去了,心魔着意遗忘了他的脸孔、声音与笑容。
如果昔日的本尊可以痛下杀手,毁其道骨,夺其道心，那他作为青出于蓝的篡位者，理应比前任更狠毒无情才是。
只可惜，他还无法获得他的头衔，至善选择谁，谁才是至恶。在这一点上，心魔自然拎得清。
他的面容涌动着山雨欲来的阴影，狰狞的神色出现不过刹那，心魔便快速收敛了杀心，专心研究起脱困的时机。
刘扶光没有说“好”，更没有说“不好”。他始终不语，唯有手指无力蜷缩，一下、两下，像一只垂死的昆虫，终于慢慢地摸索进怀中，勾到了被晏欢缩小带走的东沼。
故国的份量无比沉重，给予他踏实的脉脉温情。土地是记忆，是摇篮，故国的土地，更孕育着他的所拥有的一切。长久以来，他从东沼汲取站直身体的力量，不管发生什么事，天底下总还有一个令他心安的地方。
刘扶光索性闭上眼睛，他疲惫至极，沉入受损的识海，用假寐躲避刚刚发生的事。
恍惚中，耳边传来清澈潺潺的水流声，晏欢拧了温热的毛巾，替他小心地擦去面上干结的血和泪。带着一点烫的热气，温柔地熨帖在紧绷的肌肤上，舒适得像是一场好梦。
晏欢又轻轻哼起了那首简短的小调，这是苦恋中的女子，对丈夫久候不归的焦急呼唤。在此之前，还未有能被冠以情之名的歌谣问世。
刘扶光筋疲力竭，只想让自己暂时远离这摊子烂事，什么都不说，什么都不想。然而，听见这悠远的龙吟，他真的睡着了，并且眠而无梦。
他倚在床边，看见晏欢化成原型，像一条黑乎乎的焦油河，围着床绕了十圈八圈，把客栈的小房子塞得满满当当。见他坐起来，九颗眼珠子悄悄游过来，怯怯地觑着他的脸色。
怎么……这就过去了？天大的事，竟轻描淡写地翻了篇？他先前哭得晏欢万念俱灰，恨不能立刻千刀万剐地死了，才好偿还自己的孽债，终止这痛苦，现下怎么转得如此快？
“别站着了，”刘扶光一边收拾东西，头也不回地道，“答应了巫罗的事，总得替他完成，不能拖延。”
看到他这副样子，晏欢恍然大悟，这不是又到了他们重聚之后的状态么？那种“我不想再看到你，但是又甩不脱你，只好当你是空气无视”的状态，只不过责任所迫，刘扶光又不得不跟他说话。
“以前哪样？”刘扶光静静地道，“你觉得我又在跟你冷战，是不？”
content_en:
Invisibly, he suddenly felt the seal loosening. In his sight, the stubborn Taoist heart with brilliant golden light was trembling slightly and invisiblely. The impeccable cage around it had strong and weak waves at the same time.
The inner demons are like insects eager to drink blood, eager to pounce on the seal, and when it is loosened, they eagerly devour the energy of the outside world.
Well, it is unlikely that he died. He took the divine body and dragon heart, so he should be counted as half of the ultimate evil. Naturally, you can feel that the power of the Supreme Good is getting stronger day by day. If you think about it for a moment, you will know what good deeds I have done. In order to coax the Supreme Good Heart to bloom, he must have taken the initiative to pull out the anchor point between good and evil, and there were more than one place.
It is very likely that because he is far away from Liu Fuguang, the inner demons can think calmly without being bewitched by the evil ways of the Supreme Good. Liu Fuguang's charm faded, and his inner demon deliberately forgot his face, voice and smile.
If the former deity could kill someone, destroy his Taoist bones, and seize his Taoist heart, then as a capable usurper, he should be more vicious and ruthless than his predecessor.
It's a pity that he can't get his title yet. Whoever chooses to be the most good will be the most evil. At this point, the inner demons can naturally be dealt with.
His face was filled with the shadow of the impending rain, and the ferocious look appeared only for a moment before the inner demon quickly restrained his murderous intention and concentrated on studying the opportunity to escape.
Liu Fuguang didn't say "good", let alone "bad". He remained silent, only his fingers curled up weakly, once or twice, like a dying insect, and finally slowly groped into his arms, hooking up to Dongmao who was shrunk and taken away by Yan Huan.
The weight of his motherland is extremely heavy, giving him solid tenderness. The land is memory and the cradle, and the land of his motherland nurtures everything he owns. For a long time, he has drawn the strength to stand up straight from Dongmao. No matter what happens, there is always a place in the world that makes him feel at ease.
Liu Fuguang simply closed his eyes. He was extremely exhausted and sank into the damaged sea of ​​consciousness, using sleep to avoid what had just happened.
In a daze, the sound of clear gurgling water came to his ears. Yan Huan twisted the warm towel and carefully wiped away the dried blood and tears on his face. With a little bit of hot air, it gently presses onto the tight skin, making it feel as comfortable as a good dream.
Yan Huan softly hummed the short tune again. It was the anxious call of a woman in love to her husband who had been waiting for him for a long time. Before this, there was no ballad that could be named in the name of love.
Liu Fuguang was exhausted and just wanted to stay away from this mess for a while, without saying anything or thinking about anything. However, when he heard the distant dragon's roar, he really fell asleep without any dreams.
He leaned against the bed and saw Yan Huan transformed into a prototype, like a black tar river, circling the bed ten or eight times, filling the small inn room to the brim. Seeing him sitting up, nine eyes quietly came over and looked at his face timidly.
How... is this over? How could such a big thing be turned over in an understatement? He cried so much that Yan Huan lost all hope and wished he could be cut into pieces immediately so that he could repay his debt and end this pain. How could things change so quickly now?
"Stop standing there," Liu Fuguang said without looking back as he packed up his things. "What you promised Wu Luo must be completed for him. You can't delay it."
Seeing his appearance, Yan Huan suddenly realized that this was not the same state after they reunited? That kind of "I don't want to see you again, but I can't get rid of you, so I have to ignore you as if you were nothing", but due to responsibility, Liu Fuguang had to talk to him again.
"What was it like before?" Liu Fuguang said quietly, "You think I'm having a cold war with you again, don't you?"
